review_reference: Owner decisions relayed by the coordinator on 2026-11-11 (delete each uploaded source file, its Textract text and AI reading, and the content of its working rows after the job finishes; keep what a person saved or published, usage counts and a counts-only deletion audit; content removal through one SECURITY DEFINER purge path, append-only triggers kept). First numbered 0110, renumbered 0111, then 0112 by the coordinator on 2026-11-11 because numbers follow release order (0111 went to campaign admins, #222). SIGNED by the owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-11-11 (~10:05 UTC), changing the window from 24 hours to 7 days: "Q36, make it 7days (signed)".
evidence: Single migration 0112_ocr_source_deletion_7d.sql plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHAT IT DOES: ehr.documents.status gains 'source_deleting' and 'source_deleted'; a document is due for deletion 7 days after the latest finish of all its OCR jobs (not under legal hold), overdue at 7 days + 2 hours; the OCR worker claims due documents, deletes every S3 version of the source, and one SECURITY DEFINER purge removes the Textract text, the AI reading and the content of the job's working rows while keeping job ids and status, ocr.page_usage, ocr.ai_usage, ehr.ocr_import_provenance and published EHR rows; a counts-only audit event ocr.source.deleted_after_7d is written. ocr-api answers 410 DOCUMENT_SOURCE_DELETED ("Source page deleted after 7 days") for a deleted source, including at publication. Append-only triggers stay; the four replaced trigger functions are md5-pinned in section 0 and the migration stops with nothing applied if any pinned body differs. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: today's services never read the two new statuses; the sweeper ships in the same backend release. RELEASE ORDER: after 0111 (#222). PROVED (Session B, 2026-11-11, throwaway PostgreSQL 16 only): fresh install with all 84 database suites passing, 100 deletion cases with 7-day boundaries; ocr-worker 700, ocr-api 341, ehr-api 831, apps/ehr 7 tests; independent review found nothing Critical, High or Medium. The deletion infrastructure (Terraform, hid-system #217 on dev) is applied by the owner only after this sweeper is live.
